north-coast-500-inverness-john-o-groats.title: North Coast 500: Inverness to John o Groats
north-coast-500-inverness-john-o-groats.slogan: Inverness to John o Groats - a long day on the North Coast 500 · one way, about 610 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Inverness

waypoints.name: Ullapool

sections.advice: Inverness → Bealach na Ba climbs about 626 m in 115 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Bealach na Ba → Applecross drops about 626 m over 5 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Applecross → Ullapool is 80 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Ullapool → Durness is 98 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Durness → John o Groats is 122 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

north-coast-500-inverness-john-o-groats.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road North Coast 500. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Inverness → Bealach na Ba
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 166 km. 626 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: North Coast 500
scenicChapters.narrative: 626 m come off over 7 km at around 13.2%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

north-coast-500-inverness-john-o-groats.story: A one-way ride of 610 km, Inverness to the finish - roughly 8 h 56 in the saddle. The stops in between: Bealach na Ba, Applecross, Ullapool and Durness. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
